rows.title_full: AN ACT REGULATING THE USE OF BANK ACCOUNTS AND E-WALLETS AND PROHIBITING THE USE THEREOF FOR UNUSUAL AND SUSPICIOUS FINANCIAL ACTIVITY
rows.abstract:
Seeks to mitigate the rise of heightened cybercrime activities such as phishing, smishing, vishing, and other online fraud schemes which target bank clients, credit card holders, e-wallet accounts, online shopping, and other uses of online financial services.
Proposes to penalize money mules and social engineering schemes leading to illicit online financial activities through regulation of digital services to ensure the safety of the public and strengthen the financial system´s defense against cybercriminals.
Defines several terms such as electronic wallet, money mule, phishing, social engineering scheme, among others.

rows.author: J089
rows.title_full: AN ACT PROVIDING FOR THE DEVELOPMENT OF SUSTAINABLE CITIES AND COMMUNITIES IN THE COUNTRY, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract:
Proposes to address the issues regarding the rapid urbanization of cities and metropolitan areas that exerts pressure on the natural environment and the affordability of housing services, public safety, and health; and that the highly populated and concentrated urbanized areas are more vulnerable to disasters and the effects of climate change.
Seeks to institutionalize the policy framework for creating sustainable cities that would ensure the continuing growth of our country in pursuance of our commitment to the UNs Sustainable Development Goals (SDGS).
Tasks NEDA to set targets based on several indicators for transitioned sustainable areas:  urban population living in informal settlements (squatters); public transport access; urbanization rates; cultural heritage protection; deaths/injuries and economic losses from natural disasters; solid waste management and urban pollution; open and safe spaces; urban and regional planning; integrated/local disaster risk management, and other targets consistent with the model outlined in this Act.

rows.author: G097
rows.title_full: AN ACT INSTITUTIONALIZING THE ASSISTANCE TO INDIVIDUALS IN CRISIS SITUATION (AICS) PROGRAM AND PROVIDING FUNDS THEREFOR
rows.abstract:
Proposes to address the vulnerable conditions of many Filipinos who are in dire need of immediate relief when they face exigencies due to family matters, medical emergencies, and disasters.  These are citizens who could not go to hospitals, funeral parlors, or go back home to their provinces, who could not avail social services because they lack the financial capability and support to do so, and families with members attending online classes also face additional financial burdens to meet learning needs.
Seeks to institutionalize the AICS program to introduce a permanent national program that is financially and administratively capable of responding to the needs of Filipinos dealing with extreme circumstances.
Provides for the corresponding rates and frequency in availing various assistance such as transportation, medical, burial, educational, food, cash assistance for other support services, and provision of PPEs.

rows.title_full: AN ACT DECLARING THE PHILIPPINE MERCHANT MARINE ACADEMY AS THE NATIONAL MARITIME ACADEMY, EXPANDING ITS POWERS AND FUNCTIONS, AND APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR
rows.title_short: Philippine Merchant Marine Academy Bi Centennial Charter
rows.abstract:
Declares the Philippine Merchant Academy as the National Maritime Academy with a mission of molding merchant marine professional imbued with nationalism, leadership, traits, and positive character development and excellence in their profession, and endeavor to contribute positively to society and their respective communities.

Grants PMMA the academic freedom and institutional autonomy pursuant to paragraph 2, Section 5 of Article XIV of the Constitution; to establish a National Maritime Research and Policy Center which shall engage in research for the development and advancement of the maritime industry; and to develop, design, deploy, and confer degrees as appropriate, in accordance with the Philippine Qualifications Framework (PQF) Level II to VII and covering technical-vocational education and training (TVET), undergraduate, and graduate programs in the fields of maritime and allied disciplines, among others.

Mandates graduates of the undergraduate degree programs of the PMMA who will opt to work in the merchant marine industry, either in domestic or international trade, to provide a minimum of four (4) years cumulative full-time service to the government in any of its agencies or instrumentalities, including GOCCs, within ten (10) years after graduation. They shall also be commissioned as officers of the PN Naval Reserve Command with the rank of ensign and shall be called to serve by the Commander-in-Chief in times of war or national emergency.

AN ACT REDUCING THE EXCISE TAX ON CERTAIN PETROLEUM PRODUCTS, AMENDING FOR THE PURPOSE SECTION 148 AND ADDING SECTIONS 148-B AND 148-C IN THE NATIONAL INTERNAL REVENUE CODE OF 1997, 
AS AMENDED
rows.title_short:
Reducing The Excise Tax On Certain Petroleum Products, Amending For The Purpose Section 148 And Adding Sections 148- B And 148- C In The National Internal Revenue Code Of 1997, 
As Amended
rows.abstract:
Seeks to provide reduction of excise taxes on gasoline, diesel, kerosene and liquefied petroleum gas (LPG) for the immediate relief to the public affected by rising fuel prices.



Provides a price monitoring mechanism that will require oil companies to notify the Department of Energy (DOE) and the Department of Finance (DOF) of the retail prices, including taxes, of gasoline, kerosene, diesel fuel oil, LPG, and similar oils having more or less the same generating power a day before the implementation of the six-month excise tax rate adjustment, and of every change in the retail price until the end of the six-month period. 

Creates a Social Impact Stabilization Fund to be utilized by the Department of Social Welfare and Development for cash aid to affected land public transport entities during periods of high petroleum prices.
rows.status: Period of sponsorship/debate closed on 2021-11-22
